title: The Word Of The Guru's Shabad
summary: Purpose is being answered in the middle of pressure, not after the day has calmed down.
takeaway: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, the Lord is found. The Lord carries us across; through it, the Gurmukh is honored and approved
lifeApplication: Choose one act today that treats life as opportunity instead of drift. Use the line before the pressure chooses your tone.
